decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a cheap incremental component that upgrades the firm's core infrared heaters, so keeping the option open costs little while its value is still unresolved.
The plaque heater had its own page in 2019 and is part of the firm's narrow core range, with no evidence since then that its value has failed, though it overlaps with the standard plaque model.
The luminous radiant heater fits the established hall-heating business at low carrying cost, and with no results reported after 2019 its uncertainty is unresolved, so the option is worth keeping.
The multi-model tube heater line is a central offering for industrial halls, and no negative signal justifies giving up this option.
The standard plaque heater had its own page in 2019 and serves as a basic volume product at low carrying cost, so it should stay on the market.
This tube heater overlaps with the D line, making it a possible candidate for consolidation, but with no evidence of failure and low carrying cost it is kept for now.
